meta.title: Bidri Crafts — store demo
meta.description: Demo of the Bidri Crafts WooCommerce store. Runs entirely in your browser; nothing is saved and no real payments are taken.
meta.author: arunkumarpatil24j2007-cmd

options.blogdescription: Authentic GI-certified Bidriware, handmade in Bidar

steps.data:
<?php
// Demo only: photos are already web-sized, so skip generating resized copies (saves browser memory).
add_filter( 'intermediate_image_sizes_advanced', '__return_empty_array' );
add_filter( 'big_image_size_threshold', '__return_false' );
add_filter( 'woocommerce_background_image_regeneration', '__return_false' );

options.woocommerce_demo_store_notice: Demo store — browse freely. Orders here are not real and no money is taken.

woocommerce_cod_settings.title: Demo payment (no money is taken)
woocommerce_cod_settings.description: In the live store this step is Razorpay: UPI, cards and netbanking.
